prompts:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: six transparent PNG game UI tool icons, arranged as a clean two-column by three-row sprite sheet.
Input image: the supplied approved garden UI screenshot is the strict shape, palette, and flat paper illustration reference. Recreate its six tool icons faithfully, without the surrounding UI.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha background, no card panels, no colored background, no checkerboard baked into image.
Subjects and exact grid positions:
top left: one tan gardening glove, thumb to left and four rounded fingers pointing upward, muted sage-green cuff, tilted slightly right, matching screenshot glove.
top right: one small kraft tan seed paper bag, folded top, rounded lower corners, cream rectangular label showing only a tiny green two-leaf sprout.
middle left: one teal turquoise watering can, rounded squat body, arched top handle and right loop handle, spout pointing diagonally left with oval rose and three tiny turquoise water droplets as in reference.
middle right: one garden shovel, gray rounded pointed blade at lower left, dark gray short shaft rising right, terracotta orange oblong grip with a small pale handle opening at upper right.
bottom left: one warm ochre brown backpack, rounded rectangular body, brown top loop, darker curved flap, central small pale golden buckle and subtle right side pocket.
bottom right: one tiny shop icon, cream front with two brown vertical posts, dark brown arched doorway, orange and pale cream striped awning roof with scalloped bottom, matching reference shop.
Style/medium: soft flat painted paper cutout illustration, subtle natural paper grain within objects, simple rounded friendly silhouettes, very restrained tonal shading. Match reference colors and shapes. No black outlines, no heavy outlines, no thick border, no emoji appearance, no 3D, no photorealism, no shiny highlights, no cast shadow.
Composition/framing: six separate objects centered within six equal cells, 2 columns and 3 rows. All objects similar visual size, each occupies no more than 65% of its cell width and height, ample empty transparent padding, no object or droplet crosses a cell border. Full silhouettes with no clipped edges. No dividers.
Text: none; no letters, numbers, captions, watermark, brand marks.
Constraints: only the six listed icons, no extra elements, preserve the reference tool anatomy. Output transparent background.
Use case: background-extraction
Asset type: six game icons on a transparent 2-column 3-row sheet.
Input image 1 is the edit target, the six-icon sheet. Preserve all six icon shapes, colors, positions, spacing, internal details, and flat paper texture unchanged.
Change only background and alpha: completely remove ALL colored haze, luminous glow, brown/black background and cast shadows surrounding these objects. The entire area outside the six actual hard-edged object silhouettes and the three tiny water drops must have alpha EXACTLY ZERO. The actual objects must be fully opaque. No semi-transparent fog anywhere. Empty transparent gaps between fingers, handles, and tools. Clean antialiased silhouette boundaries only.
Keep the tan glove with green cuff, seed bag, turquoise watering can and its three drops, gray shovel with orange grip, brown backpack, and orange-roof little store. Do not redraw, relocate, add or remove parts of these six icons. Do not add background, border, labels, text, lines, panels, shadows, glow, or extra objects. Actual transparent PNG alpha channel, not simulated transparency.
